title: 🎨 Modernize Style
content: Update to contemporary design aesthetics. Apply glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-md and bg-white/20 on cards. Add gradient accents using bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-purple-600 on buttons and highlights. Use modern typography with proper font weights and letter-spacing. Include subtle shadows (shadow-xl) with colored tints. Add rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for softer appearance. Implement smooth transitions on all interactive elements. Use contemporary color palette with vibrant accents. Add subtle border effects with border-white/20.

variants.simple: Update to modern design with glassmorphism, gradients, and soft shadows.

variants.advanced: Update to contemporary design aesthetics with modern techniques. Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70 dark:bg-gray-900/70 border border-white/20 shadow-xl - use for cards, modals, nav bars floating over content. Gradients: bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-purple-600 for primary buttons, bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-purple-50 for hero backgrounds, text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r for gradient text. Shadows: shadow-xl shadow-blue-500/10 for colored shadow tints, multiple shadows for depth (shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/25). Soft shapes: rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-3xl for hero sections, rounded-full for buttons and badges. Typography: Inter or system-ui font, tracking-tight on headlines, font-medium for emphasis instead of bold. Borders: border border-gray-200/50 dark:border-gray-700/50 for subtle definition, ring-1 ring-gray-900/5 for elevated elements. Hover effects: hover:shadow-2xl hover:shadow-blue-500/20 transition-all duration-300. Background patterns: subtle dot grid using radial-gradient, or mesh gradient using multiple overlapping gradients. Micro-textures: subtle noise overlay using SVG filter for depth. Color palette: use vibrant accents (violet, fuchsia, cyan) against neutral backgrounds. Ensure glassmorphism has sufficient contrast for accessibility.
